title: Lock check
author: Iced-Cream
description: The smallest user of core-ar2's lockable parameters (core 0.8): three lockable sound fields, LOCK CHECK A, B and C (0..1000, a value above 127); A and C are also LFO destinations and appear at the end of every sound's LFO destination list, B is not. A bar along the bottom of the screen shows the offset track 1's LFO gives A or C, from the middle. A LOCK CHECK page behind the LFO key shows A on knob A and C on knob B, for track 1's sound, so RANDOMIZE PAGE and RELOAD PAGE can be tried on it, and with a trig held its p-lock, which a second bar shows while the trig plays. From 1.6 a fourth field, D, an LFO destination whose short name, name and category are longer than core shows, to check core's cut; and two more bars for C: its value as the active scene and the performances leave it, and the lock of the trig track 1 plays. From 1.7 (core 0.9) B is declared "smooth": false, and every audio block it records core_param_value of A, B and C on track 1 with the targets of A and C in a ring of 512 blocks (lc_ring, after the magic SMCK), with what the three calls cost in DMA timer 0's ticks, for the emulator's checks of the smoothed value. From 1.8 A and C are also declared "mod": true, so they end every sound's VELOCITY MOD and AFTERTOUCH lists, and the ring's values of A and C carry what a route to them adds (core_mod_offset), B is not. From 1.9 (core 0.9) a kit field, K, the FX track's: lockable, an FX LFO destination with a CC, on knob A of a LOCK CHECK FX page behind the FX LFO key, and the ring also carries core_param_value of K on track 12, K in the kit, the FX LFO's offset to K, and its p-lock, scene lock and performance offset. From 1.10 (core 0.10) a sound field N with "init": 100, so it reads 100 in a new project: lockable, an LFO destination with a CC, on knob C of the LOCK CHECK page, and recorded at the last block (lc_init, after the magic INIT): core_param_value of N, N in the sound, its LFO offset, p-lock and scene lock. From 1.12 (core 0.11) B on knob D of the LOCK CHECK page, a 4-bit field shown on the dial's 0..127 (core_param_scales, core's linear map), so its held locks, depths, NRPN and text match the knob. From 1.13 the ring, lc_init and lc_batch are written every 8th audio block, not every block (the reads cost 8.8 % of the Rytm's CPU per block).
